prompt:
You are an automated HTML rendering engine. Output a complete, beautifully styled Tic-Tac-Toe game in a SINGLE standalone HTML document.

Requirements:
- All CSS and JavaScript must be embedded directly inside <style> and <script> tags within the HTML.
- Use a modern, dark-mode visual aesthetic with clean typography and smooth hover transitions.
- Include win/tie state detection and a "Restart Game" button.
- STRICT FORMATTING: Do NOT return JSON, do NOT escape newline characters, and do NOT wrap your response in markdown code fences (```html). Your very first character must be '<' from <!DOCTYPE html> and your very last character must be '>'.
rawOutput:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Tic-Tac-Toe</title>
<style>
/* Modern dark theme */
body {
    background: #1e1e2e;
    color: #e0e0f2;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    margin: 0;
}
.container {
    text-align: center;
}
h1 {
    margin: 20px 0;
    font-size: 2.5rem;
}
.board {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 100px);
    gap: 5px;
}
.cell {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    background: #444;
    border: 2px solid #666;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s, border 0.2s;
}
.cell:hover {
    background: #666;
    border-color: #a0a0ff;
}
.ai-cell {
    background: #555;
}
.winner {
    margin-top: 30px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
}
.tie {
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}
button {
    padding: 10px 20px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: #4caf50;
    color: #fff;
    transition: background 0.2s;
}
.restart {
    margin-top: 20px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    background: #ff9800;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const board = document.querySelector('.board');
    const cells = board.querySelectorAll('.cell');
    let xPlayer = 'X';
    let oPlayer = 'O';
    let gameActive = true;

    function resetGame() {
        cells.forEach(cell => {
            cell.classList.remove('ai-cell');
            cell.classList.remove('winner');
            cell.classList.remove('tie');
            cell.textContent = '';
        });
        xPlayer = 'X';
        oPlayer = 'O';
        cells.forEach(cell => cell.focus());
    }

    function checkWinner() {
        const winPatterns = [
            [0,1,2], [3,4,5], [6,7,8],
            [0,3,6], [1,4,7], [2,5,8],
            [0,4,8], [2,4,6]
        ];
        cells.forEach((cell, i) => {
            const id = cell.dataset.idx;
            if (cells[i].textContent === xPlayer || cells[i].textContent === oPlayer) continue;
            const a = board.cells[i];
            const b = board.cells[i+3];
            const c = board.cells[i+6];
            if (a && b && a.textContent === b && b.textContent === c) {
                document.querySelector('.winner').textContent = xPlayer === oPlayer ? 'X' : (xPlayer === 'X' ? 'O' : 'O');
                cells.forEach(c => c.classList.add('winner'));
                return true;
            }
        });
        return false;
    }

    function handleClick(e) {
        if (!gameActive) return;
        const cell = e.target;
        if (cell.classList.contains('ai-cell')) return;
        cell.classList.add('ai-cell');
        cells.forEach(c => c.classList.add('winner'));
        board.dataset.result = 'in progress';
        const winner = checkWinner();
        if (winner) {
            gameActive = false;
            document.querySelector('.winner').textContent = winner;
        } else if (cells.filter(c => !c.classList.contains('ai-cell')).length === 0) {
            board.dataset.result = 'tie';
            document.querySelector('.tie').textContent = 'Draw!';
        }
        cells.forEach(cell => cell.focus());
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        cells[i].addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    }

    const restartBtn = document.querySelector('.restart');
    restartBtn.addEventListener('click', resetGame);
    document.querySelectorAll('.cell').forEach(cell => cell.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (gameActive) handleClick(e);
    });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
